Hate to rain on everybody's parade, but ''xusra'' doesn't really mean "prophet"; it means 'asserts'.

''lo xusra'' is a person or agent who asserts things. A prophet is a ''lo xusra'', though there are things which are ''lo xusra'' besides prophets.Its just a minor liberty with the translation. [[File:icon_smile.gif|:-)]]

A better thing to point out is that I had Spanish on the brain when translating ''tu se mi'u di'u''. I've changed the ''you'' in my translation to ''that'' now.

''Besides, people are already making [http://www.lojban.org/tiki/Year+2000 references to the porous prophet].'' Also [http://www.lojban.org/wiki/index.php/Lojban%20Anthem here].
